g.text: Yeah, well. You're not exactly making me want to stick around.
For saying you will leave us here
Even if it's true... Even if you do leave us someday and don't come back
I know it would be for the right reasons
I attacked you and it was wrong
You need to learn to stop taking your shit out on other people.
I... lash out when I get afraid, babas, and that is not your fault
I... lash out when I get afraid, babas, and that is not your fault
*You're* afraid of something? Holy shit, get Eleanor, we have a newspaper article to write.
Of no change, of no death
So the fact that you can just LEAVE
I would run as far and fast as I could from here
I guess because I've lived through a loop before, I'm not so scared of it.
Yeah, but... I have something valuable keeping me here.
But you'll get bored in time
Like Amir with his little games
El chamaco is surrounded by those cassettes and keeps saying he has nothing to play
You'll do the same to us
Toss us aside like a game you're tired of
Because we are so special to you
You can choose to believe me or not.
I can't make promises about the future, Lettie. It hasn't been written yet.
I'm sure you and I could find ways of keeping things interesting... ;)
Back to it for both of us
I just came to say I am sorry and explain why, that is all
Oh, the games we could play
Back to it for both of us
